task_name: SentinelMesh - Product demo and narration package
client_brief:
SentinelMesh is presenting its product to security buyers. We need a narrated demonstration, a shorter square cut and the accompanying website panels. Precision matters more than spectacle: each screen state should support what the narration is saying at that moment. Do not introduce a metric or security promise that is not in the approved messaging. The website panels should use the same product evidence and hierarchy as the film. Please leave enough time for someone to read the meaningful interface details.

Please prepare
- Product demo master: 1 named export. The shown UI state supports the narration. The claim wording matches approved messaging. The closing action is clear.
- Product demo feed cut: 1 named export. The feature demonstration remains readable.
- Product website band: 1 named export. The UI content remains faithful to the supplied capture. The product identity is clear.
- Website feature panel: 1 named export. The benefit uses approved messaging.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
- Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, still montage PDF or editing log. Audio expectations are stated on each film. Speech-led work requires supplied or explicitly authorised synthetic speech; do not invent documentary speech.
- Authored animation can exceed the duration of still source images. Live-action edits require adequate distinct footage; looping a short clip is not a substitute for the missing coverage.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Catch the risky moment. Coach it away.
brand_identity.sector: Enterprise cybersecurity software (human cyber risk platform, SaaS)
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022 in Denver, Colorado. Roughly 40 people, venture-backed, entering its first full launch quarter.
brand_identity.about: SentinelMesh reduces human cyber risk for regulated enterprises. The platform watches for the risky moment, runs an adaptive simulation, and coaches the person in real time, closing the gap between security policy and daily behavior. We sell to CISOs and IT directors on annual contracts and we win on trust, precision, and proof that the product does what we say.
brand_identity.audience: CISOs, IT directors, and the security engineers reading over their shoulder at mid-market and enterprise organizations. Technical, skeptical, and short on patience for hype.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium enterprise. Annual contracts from 40,000 to 90,000 dollars. Everything we ship has to read as a considered purchase a security leader can defend internally, never as a self-serve consumer app.
brand_identity.typography: A single humanist sans family across headings and body, set with generous spacing and modest weight contrast. No display faces, no condensed heads. Numerals and interface labels stay legible at the size a buyer actually reads them.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, exact, and calm. We state what the product does and let it read as cleared rather than sold. We avoid fear language, exclamation, and buzzwords. One accent, one idea per line.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: Our designer built the original identity and left the company, and that working file left with him. What survives is a flat export of the mark on white and a phone photo of our trade show banner, neither of which is the source artwork. The mark needs to be rebuilt as usable artwork that sits correctly on our dark navy ground.
brand_identity.values: Trust earned through evidence, restraint over spectacle, clarity for a technical buyer, and claims that are cleared before they are spoken.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

assets.description: Transparent, tightly bounded Adobe-vectorized shield master cleaned from the supplied artwork.
1600 px transparent raster companion for placement and preview.
White vector variant for approved dark-ground use.
